channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Dune Day in Schaeberle Crater
item.description: The light-colored, rough surface is covered with small impact craters, showing that this landscape has been exposed for a long time. Resting on top of this older terrain are smooth, dark dunes that formed by wind-blown sand. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
